site.name: SomitiKhata
site.tagline: Digital savings, loans, and shared assets for cooperative communities.

hero.title: A clearer way to manage savings, loans, and shared assets.
hero.description: SomitiKhata helps committees track deposits, view member balances, and keep shared asset records organized with clarity and trust.

sections.howItWorksTitle: A simple workflow designed for real committees
steps: Committee members verify each account before access is approved.
Members register with a trusted phone or email identity.
Committee staff log deposits and repayments in a single ledger.
Members can view balances, shares, and loan status without confusion.
sections.featuresTitle: Everything a cooperative needs to stay organized

features.title: Savings tracking
features.description: Monitor every deposit, current balance, and monthly history with less paperwork and fewer errors.

features.title: Loan overview
features.description: Keep applications, approvals, repayment schedules, and outstanding balances in one clear place.

features.title: Shared asset share
features.description: See each member’s contribution to shared property and understand asset value without manual calculations.

features.title: Bilingual access
features.description: Switch between English and Bangla without losing context, route flow, or important navigation.

trustPoints: Access is controlled for authorized members and committee staff only.
Important events are recorded in a structured way so nothing is left ambiguous.
The platform keeps records clear enough for a committee to review them with confidence.
sections.faqTitle: Common questions from committees and members

faq.question: Do members need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes, members can check balances and savings activity from a phone with internet access. Committee-side deposit and review work is designed for the online administration flow.

faq.question: Can paper records still be kept?
faq.answer: Yes. The system is designed to support the committee’s day-to-day recordkeeping rather than replace it entirely.

faq.question: Can members self-register?
faq.answer: The intended flow is approval-based. New members are added through a committee-controlled pre-approval setup before full access is granted.

faq.question: Is this secure?
faq.answer: This phase focuses on a reviewable, trustworthy UI and route structure. Security hardening and real backend logic are planned for the later implementation stages.
